purpose: Readability review candidates, not defects. Immutable planning baseline; record final dispositions separately by id.

methodology.discovery: Sorted unique git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z paths; includes working-tree edits and non-ignored untracked source.
methodology.codeSelection: Paths ending .ts, .mjs, .cjs, .js, except .d.ts. ts.createSourceFile with ScriptTarget.Latest and TS or JS ScriptKind; this repository had no in-scope TSX/JSX implementation.
methodology.testClassification: Path contains /test/ or .test.; includes test support and fixtures, not only executable test cases.
methodology.hash: SHA-256 of sorted selected paths, each UTF-8 path + NUL + current source + NUL. Excludes this JSON and the Markdown plan.
methodology.conditionSelection: IfStatement, ConditionalExpression, WhileStatement expressions. Flag logical operator count >= 5 OR approximate line span >= 12 OR a function-like expression with >= 2 logical operators. Count includes nested callback content.
methodology.functionSelection: Every function-like node with body. Flag >= 3 catches OR control nesting >= 5 OR approximate line span >= 160. Within each function skip nested function bodies; nested functions are assessed separately. Count nesting for if, for, for-of, while, try; this is not formal cognitive/cyclomatic complexity.
methodology.lineMetric: Original scan span is end zero-based line minus start one-based line plus 2. It is an approximate screening metric, not a target or style rule. Locator line is one-based node start.
methodology.literalSelection: Non-test string literal text matching /^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{4,63}$/ except .js suffix; >=4 occurrences in >=2 files. Counts do not establish common meaning, missed numbers/embedded SQL/long literals require manual review.
methodology.reproduction: Repeat this discovery and TypeScript-AST traversal on current source. Sort candidates by file and node line, compare by file/symbol and surrounding code rather than line number alone. Keep this snapshot and store a dated follow-up separately.
limitations: No proof of exhaustive semantic review or behavioral correctness.
No .d.ts, ignored dist/node_modules/coverage, runtime artifacts, or secrets.
SQL, YAML, JSON, shell, docs, regex complexity, embedded script strings and non-flagged code require manual review.
Large suite callbacks and declarative functions are frequent false positives.
Condition and function candidate sets overlap; do not add them as a defect count.
